questions_and_answers.question_text: रोज़ सवेरे हम नौ बजे स्कूल आ चुके हैं ।

answers.answer_text: Every morning we have already arrived at school by nine o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: कल पांच बजे तक आपकी माता जी यहाँ पहुँच चुकीं ।

answers.answer_text: By five o'clock tomorrow your mother will have arrived here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: पिछले महीने मैं रोज़ सवेरे नौ बजे से पहले स्कूल पहुँच चुका था ।

answers.answer_text: Last month I had been reaching school before nine o'clock every morning.

questions_and_answers.question_text: खाना खा चुकने के बाद हम लोग सिनेमा देखने गये ।

answers.answer_text: After finishing our meal we went to see a movie.

questions_and_answers.question_text: उनके जा चुकने के बाद हमने बातचीत शुरू की ।

answers.answer_text: After they had left we began to converse.

questions_and_answers.question_text: मैं अपना सब काम खत्म कर चुका ।

answers.answer_text: I have finished all my work.

questions_and_answers.question_text: हमारे पहुँचने से पहले वे खाना खा चुके थे ।

answers.answer_text: They had eaten before we arrived.
